items.title: `uv tool upgrade --all` does not update anything
items.reason: Closest historical symptom match: on uv 0.10.10, outdated tools, including tombi, remained unchanged with 'Nothing to upgrade', while reinstalling with @latest worked. Closed by astral-sh/uv#18586, which fixed outdated checks ignoring saved settings. The new report occurs after that fix and explicitly excludes a configured cooldown.

items.title: Respect installed settings in `uv tool list --outdated`
items.reason: Merged March 21, 2026, closing astral-sh/uv#18522. Its diff makes outdated checks use saved index, prerelease and exclude-newer settings and consider the tool interpreter; its regression test covers a saved exclude-newer cutoff. Commit ancestry confirms this fix is in 0.13.0, but the same underlying failure has not been established here.

items.title: Issue with tool versioning
items.reason: Same outdated-list/upgrade-no-op symptom on uv 0.11.19. A maintainer requested verbose upgrade output to check for pins; the reporter supplied verbose list output and closed after installing markitdown@latest. No fixing PR or confirmed cause appears in its timeline, so closure does not establish a fix.

items.title: Bug: `uv tool upgrade` doesn't respect changes to the global `exclude-newer` setting
items.reason: Adjacent upgrade blocker on the same uv, Python and platform versions: an inherited cooldown persists in the tool receipt after global configuration changes. This makes saved receipt options relevant evidence, but the new report denies exclude-newer configuration and does not establish that mechanism; it is not a confirmed duplicate.

items.title: Surface pinned-version hint when `uv tool upgrade` can’t move the tool
items.reason: Implemented the exact-pin explanation requested in astral-sh/uv#15665; current source and integration tests contain that hint. Relevant to the secondary request for an explanation, but it only diagnoses exact version pins, and @latest does not persist such a pin.

items.title: Warn when `--upgrade-package <name>` does not result in an upgrade
items.reason: Tracks the broader request to explain why requested upgrades cannot proceed, with maintainer discussion of resolver incompatibilities and Python requirements. It concerns --upgrade-package diagnostics rather than this tool-upgrade failure, so it overlaps only with the report's secondary request.

related.search_scope: Searched astral-sh/uv open and closed issues and open, closed and merged PRs through authenticated gh. Separated upgrade failure from missing explanations. Literal searches covered 'Nothing to upgrade', tool upgrade, tool list --outdated, @latest, tombi and 0.13.0; conceptual searches covered upgrade refusal, pins, constraints, warnings and area:uv-tool. Separately searched saved exclude-newer settings as a possible cause. PR searches returned no hits; followed issue timelines to inspect merged fixes, comments, diffs and release ancestry. Ruled out astral-sh/uv#19325 (dependency-only upgrades missing from the list), astral-sh/uv#8276 (explicit pins), astral-sh/uv#17548 (Windows executable-copy failure), and astral-sh/uv#21058 / astral-sh/uv#21368 (invalid tool directories, already fixed). Also checked astral-sh/uv#18819 / astral-sh/uv#18861 (exclude-newer support), astral-sh/uv#12052 (unreproduced transient failure) and astral-sh/uv#13733 (project dependency upgrade conflicts). No confirmed open duplicate of the reported failure was found.

type_reason: The report describes a failed upgrade and misleading output for an allegedly unconstrained tool. The similar historical bug in astral-sh/uv#18522 was fixed by astral-sh/uv#18586, and that fix is included in 0.13.0. This recurrence warrants investigation as a possible regression or an uncovered case, not closure as a duplicate of the fixed issue. The underlying mechanism remains unconfirmed; the inspected open issues do not establish the same failure.
summary: Closest matches are astral-sh/uv#18522 and its merged fix astral-sh/uv#18586, plus the unresolved cause behind closed astral-sh/uv#19704. Saved cooldowns and upgrade explanations have adjacent discussions, but no confirmed open duplicate was found.
draft_response:
Installing with `@latest` does not save an exact version pin, so that syntax alone should not prevent future upgrades. astral-sh/uv#18522 was fixed by astral-sh/uv#18586, which made outdated checks respect saved tool settings; that fix is included in 0.13.0. astral-sh/uv#19704 closed after reinstalling, without a confirmed cause.

Before reinstalling tombi, please share the output of `uv tool upgrade tombi -v` and `uv tool list --outdated --show-version-specifiers --show-python`, plus tombi's saved requirements and options from its `uv-receipt.toml`, with credentials removed. Those details are needed to determine why the upgrade keeps 1.8.1 and whether this is a regression.
